No issue with removing same target twice? She didn't remove shoulder again; she just decapitated. Shoulder remains part of body after wound.

No repeated irreversible removal on same specific target: no. Shoulder not removed. Head removed once. So fine.

Check if entire body/object becomes materially different substance or vanish without cause: Decapitating removes head, but that's a normal physical action. No issue.
